We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then parse peaks for methyl (singlet, doublet, triplet around 0.9-1.2 ppm). Count number of distinct CH3 groups. Might need to consider overlapping signals. Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That may be easier: count number of signals in that region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
